sources.title: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions: 2025 final figures announcement
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions: 2025 final figures announcement.
The announced final 2025 release is scheduled for February 2027 and is not observed data on 25 July 2026.
Future release announcement only.

sources.title: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions: 2026 provisional figures announcement
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions: 2026 provisional figures announcement.
The announced provisional 2026 release is scheduled for March 2027 and is not observed data on 25 July 2026.
Future release announcement only.

sources.title: DESNZ Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Provisional UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2025.
Publication provides provisional territorial GHG estimates for 2025 including quarterly estimates.
Provisional territorial statistics; subject to revision.

sources.title: DESNZ 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional statistical release
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional statistical release.
In 2025 domestic transport was 31% of net UK territorial GHG emissions; sectoral provisional estimates have additional uncertainty.
Provisional sector estimates; some non-energy sectors use projections.

sources.title: DESNZ 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional methodology summary
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ 2025 UK greenhouse gas emissions provisional methodology summary.
Methodology notes that much provisional non-energy GHG is derived using projected percentage changes.
Methodology/model input; projection-derived values are not direct observations.

sources.title: DESNZ UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions, 2005 to 2024
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions, 2005 to 2024.
Accredited official statistics provide local-authority and regional GHG estimates for 2005 to 2024.
Local-authority/regional estimates; geography is not parcel binding.

sources.title: DfT Department for Transport forthcoming publications
facts: Official public source reviewed: DfT Department for Transport forthcoming publications.
The schedule lists future transport releases including September 2026 provisional road traffic and later RTFO/EV releases.
Forthcoming-publication schedule; future releases are not observed data.

sources.title: DESNZ Independent review on greenhouse gas removals: government response
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Independent review on greenhouse gas removals: government response.
Government response discusses engineered and nature-based removals, market frameworks and CCUS-linked delivery.
Policy response; not measured parcel removals.

sources.title: DfT Statistics at DfT
facts: Official public source reviewed: DfT Statistics at DfT.
Latest statistics list includes SAF and RTFO fifth provisional releases on 23 July, vehicle licensing on 15 July, and transport/environment on 14 July 2026.
Statistics index; individual release status must be preserved.

sources.title: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026.
Conversion factors enable calculation and reporting of GHG emissions from UK activities in 2026.
Conversion factors are calculation inputs, not measured emissions.

sources.title: Defra Emissions of air pollutants in the UK — Ammonia
facts: Official public source reviewed: Defra Emissions of air pollutants in the UK — Ammonia.
UK ammonia emissions were 256 thousand tonnes in 2024; agriculture contributed 89%.
Air-pollutant inventory; ammonia is not GHG CO2e and must not be conflated.

sources.title: DESNZ UK Energy in Brief: 2025 announcement
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ UK Energy in Brief: 2025 announcement.
The announced UK Energy in Brief 2025 release is scheduled for 30 July 2026, after the 25 July review date.
Future release announcement only.
